description: List of expenses - perhaps for building? In Judaeo-Arabic and Greek/Coptic numerals. Dating: the year was recorded in the recto heading l. 2 but some of the digits are unclear: 5[.]52(?) AM. The paleography supports a century estimate of 5[2]52 or 5[1]51 AM– the hand looks too early for it to be 5[3]52 AM. Mentions ḥawsh Isḥāq. Requires further examination.
description_he: רשימת הוצאות — אולי לבנייה? מאוחר. השנה נרשמה בכותרת הרקטו אך רוב הספרות אינן ברורות.
